metadata.case_name: WONG ROCKY LOK KUN v. WU KWONG SUM

plaintiff.occupation_before: Ground services agent at the Hong Kong International Airport; work title: customer services supervisor

injuries.description: Major Depressive Disorder Single Episode, Mild
source: Mr Wong consulted Dr Gabriel Hung for psychiatric assessment for the first time in May 2015. Dr Hung’s diagnosis was “Major Depressive Disorder Single Episode, Mild”.
Mr Wong was diagnosed with major depressive disorder in May 2015.

manifestations.description: loss of interest in things he used to enjoy
poor concentration and attention affecting work performance
difficulty remembering new information and materials in new job

treatments_received.treatment: Psychiatric assessment by Dr Gabriel Hung
source: Mr Wong consulted Dr Gabriel Hung for psychiatric assessment for the first time in May 2015. Dr Hung’s diagnosis was “Major Depressive Disorder Single Episode, Mild”. He attended further assessments by Dr Hung in 2015, 2016 and early 2017.

treatments_received.treatment: Therapeutic treatment by Dr Cindy Chiu (specialist in psychiatry)
source: He also received therapeutic treatment by Dr Cindy Chiu, a specialist in psychiatry.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: “She became unhappy all the time and was socially withdrawn. She became quiet and they did not have much communication. [The wife] became sexually cold and uninterested. She refused the Plaintiff from all kinds of intimacy. The couple did not have any sexual intercourse ever since their daughter was born.”
His concentration and attention became poor and this affected his work performance.

In March 2016, Mr Wong quit his job as customer services supervisor and took up a less stressful job as an operations trainee at HACTL at the airport. In his new job, he found it difficult at times to remember all the new information and materials.
The wife filed for divorce in 2015. On the family side, he only had limited access to his daughter. He missed her a lot.
